Chapter 498: Chapter 5 Chikun Star Lord: My Apprentice, Surpassed Me? (Subscribe Please)

Outside the Milky Way Star Region.

Three figures converged.

These three figures were the very trio who had previously attempted to assassinate Lin Yuan.

At this moment, the three Eighth Layer Invincibles were looking horrified and weak. In order to escape from the Galaxy Master’s pursuit, they had paid a heavy price.

“The Galaxy Master… how can he be so strong?”

One of the figures trembled as he spoke. Initially, the five Eighth Layer Invincibles thought the mission to assassinate a Newly Advanced to the Eighth Rank Evolver would be simple.

...

Wasn’t it meant to be an easy catch?

Even if that Galaxy Master was a genius, what of it?

But reality had slapped them in the face. If they hadn’t run so quickly, they would probably have been left behind in the Milky Way Star Region forever.

Although the three Eighth Layer Invincibles each had an Avatar, they had invested countless resources into creating these avatars, and losing one would cause them long-lasting heartache.

“How did the Insect Race conduct their business, not even clearing up the Galaxy Master’s background before sending us to assassinate him?” the second Eighth Layer Invincible couldn’t help but protest.

The Galaxy Master was too strong.

So strong that it made the hearts of Eighth Layer Invincibles tremble.

Under such circumstances, there was undoubtedly a problem with the Insect Race.

“Yeah, how did the Insect Race collect their intelligence?” the third Eighth Layer Invincible also complained discontentedly.

…

On the Milky Way Main Star.

Countless Evolvers were watching the recent events with utter shock.

What had they seen?

Five Eighth Layer Invincible Different Species were easily repelled by the Galaxy Master?

Ordinary Evolvers couldn’t see much, only knowing that the five Eighth Layer Invincibles had retreated on their own accord.

But Eighth Rank Evolvers could roughly see that the Galaxy Master was pursuing and effortlessly striking down the two Eighth Layer Invincibles.

Striking down?

Eighth Layer Invincibles?

These were completely incompatible terms.

Even if an Eighth Layer Invincible were to be struck down, it would be by a Ninth Rank strong one or by certain war weapons.

Struck down by a Newly Advanced to the Eighth Rank Galaxy Master?

Had the world gone mad?

“When did the Star Lord become so strong?”

“How could I possibly feel that those Eighth Layer Invincibles are so weak…”

“How could Eighth Layer Invincibles be weak? Did you forget the spatial pressure they caused the moment those five Different Species appeared?”

“It’s not the Eighth Layer Invincibles being weak, it’s the Star Lord that’s too strong.”

Chun Bo and Jia Li, two Eighth Rank Evolvers on the Milky Way Main Star, were excitedly discussing among themselves.

Hongpi and Blue Eyes were the same, staring in shock at the Galaxy Master revealing the strength to easily subdue Eighth Layer Invincibles.

They had followed the Chikun Star Lord and knew well the power of Eighth Layer Invincibles; not even the Chikun Star Lord could strike down an Eighth Layer Invincible.

Suppressing an Eighth Layer Invincible was possible, but to defeat or even kill… was as hard as ascending to heaven.

“The Galaxy Master…”

Outside the Milky Way Main Star, Captain Nolan was parched, as he had seen even more than those Eighth Rank Evolvers on the star.

From the moment those five Eighth Layer Invincible Different Species appeared, to their panicked escape, he had seen it all.

“The myth of Eighth Layer Invincibles has been broken by the Galaxy Master…” Nolan thought rapidly.

The so-called myth of Eighth Layer Invincibles was that they were absolutely invincible among their peers and could not be killed by another of the same rank.

Eighth Layer Invincibles were the absolute peak within the Eighth Layer and so on.

To strike down an Eighth Layer Invincible, there were only two methods: one was for a higher rank strong one to act, the other was to wield some powerful ‘external force.’

Here, ‘external force’ referred to weapons, artifacts for attack, treasures, and so on.

On the Battlefields of Different Races, occasionally there would be a spectacle of strong ones wielding Supreme Weapons.

That was ‘external force.’

But the Galaxy Master had not used any external forces just now.

This fact was clear to those five Eighth Layer Invincibles, and Nolan was clear on it as well.

Not using external forces, yet easily killing Eighth Layer Invincibles, wasn’t this a shattering of the myth?

Woosh.

Just as Captain Nolan was still in shock.

A figure suddenly appeared before him.

It was none other than the Galaxy Master.

“I’ll be taking these Tai Micro Clear Crystals,” Lin Yuan said.

He had been intending to collect the Tai Micro Clear Crystals when he was interrupted by the five Eighth Layer Invincibles. Now that he had dealt with them, he naturally planned to finish what he had been doing.

“Very well.”

“Galaxy Master, please sign for them,” Nolan immediately reacted.

He then said with utmost respect.

Nolan’s reverence came completely from the heart, without any other factors.

Before this day, Nolan’s respect for Lin Yuan stemmed from his background, talent, and various other aspects.

But now, it was entirely because of strength.

Just like numerous Evolvers from Human Civilization, who revered the Nine Supreme Beings.

Hum.

As Lin Yuan confirmed his identity and signed for the delivery,

with a thought, he started transferring one space device after another from the battleship into his Inner World.

The Tai Micro Clear Crystals purchased with eighty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals were amassed, enough to match the size of dozens of planets.

Captain Nolan was close to the peak of the Eighth Rank, and his Inner World spanned only a few thousand miles in radius, incapable of accommodating all the Tai Micro Clear Crystals.

And as for putting space devices filled with massive amounts of Tai Micro Clear Crystals into one’s Inner World… that depended on the bearing limit of the Inner World itself.

A space device containing a planet-sized amount of materials couldn’t be stored within an Inner World the size of a few hundred miles in radius.

But for Lin Yuan, these Tai Micro Clear Crystals were not a problem.

Even without having expanded it, Lin Yuan’s Inner World was already tens of millions of miles in radius.

Forget eighty thousand Cubic Universe Crystals’ worth of Tai Micro Clear Crystals, even eight hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals’ worth could be easily accommodated.

…

Inside the palace on the Milky Way Main Star.

After Lin Yuan had taken all the Tai Micro Clear Crystals into his Inner World, he returned directly here.

“Let’s take a look at the spoils of war…” With a thought, Lin Yuan made two spatial wrists appear before him.
